titleEn: Law on the Establishment of Ministry of Civil Service

articles.en:
The Ministry of Civil Service is hereby established under the Royal Government of the Kingdom of Cambodia.
Article 2: The Ministry of Civil Service shall have the competence to lead and manage the civil service sector of the Kingdom of Cambodia.
The Ministry of Civil Service shall be led by one Minister, who shall be assisted by Secretaries of State and/or Under-Secretaries of State as necessary.
The organisation and functioning of the Ministry of Civil Service shall be determined by sub-decree.

Royal Kram No. NS/RKM/0196/24 dated 24 January 1996 promulgating the Law on the Establishment of the Secretariat of Civil Service is hereby repealed, and any provisions contrary to this Law shall be considered null and void.

This Law is declared to be urgent.
Done at the Royal Palace, [date illegible]; Royal signature and seal, Norodom Sihamoni, having respectfully submitted to the King for signature; Prime Minister, Samdech Akka Moha Sena Padei Techo Hun Sen; certified true copy for distribution, Phnom Penh, [date illegible] 2013.
